definitions.gloss: to have a coughing fit, to cough repeatedly

examples.japanese: {煙|けむり}で{咳|せ}き{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: I had a coughing fit from the smoke.

examples.japanese: {風邪|かぜ}で{咳|せ}き{込|こ}んでいる。
examples.english: I'm having coughing fits from a cold.

examples.japanese: {食事中|しょくじちゅう}に{咳|せ}き{込|こ}んでしまった。
examples.english: I had a coughing fit while eating.

notes:
{咳|せ}き{込|こ}む describes continuous, uncontrollable coughing — not a single cough but a sustained fit. The {込|こ}む suffix adds the nuance of intensity or becoming engulfed in the action.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive)
- No transitive pair

ASPECT (ている):
{咳|せ}き{込|こ}んでいる describes an ongoing coughing fit in progress.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {煙|けむり}で{咳|せ}き{込|こ}む: to have a coughing fit from smoke
- {風邪|かぜ}で{咳|せ}き{込|こ}む: to cough from a cold
- ひどく{咳|せ}き{込|こ}む: to cough violently

RELATED:
- {咳|せき}: cough (noun)
- {咳|せき}をする: to cough (single or general)
- {咳|せき}が{出|で}る: to have a cough (involuntary)
